title: Quantized Coulomb Branches of Separated Cotangent Type and Orthosymplectic Quivers
summary: We propose a definition of the quantized Coulomb branches of separated cotangent type, and prove that the corresponding classical construction recovers the non-cotangent Coulomb branch. We also obtain a formula for quasi-minuscule monopole operators in arbitrary cotangent type. Applying these results, we compute the monopole operators for orthosymplectic quivers and construct a homomorphism from the shifted twisted Yangian of split ADE type to the corresponding quantized Coulomb branch algebra.
